en.title: Global Wealth Flow Monitor — diverging US fund demand, gold positioning and reserve diversification
en.deck: US domestic equity outflows contrasted with world-equity inflows, money-market funds rebuilt liquidity, and gold ETF purchases diverged from Treasury yields and futures positioning.
en.regime: Selective risk demand: volatile fund flows, large liquid buffers, positive physical gold ETF buying, and gradual official reserve diversification.
en.key_risk: A negative combined fund-flow reading alongside rebuilding money-market balances may signal more selective risk demand rather than broad-based rotation.

en.search_text: Long-term U.S. fund flows turned slightly negative as ETF issuance fell short of mutual-fund withdrawals; money-market assets rose to $7.96tn and gold ETFs still attracted inflows.

pt-BR.title: Global Wealth Flow Monitor — fluxos americanos divergentes, ouro e diversificação de reservas
pt-BR.deck: Saídas de ações americanas contrastaram com entradas em fundos internacionais, fundos monetários recompuseram liquidez e ETFs de ouro divergiram de juros e futuros.
pt-BR.regime: Demanda seletiva: fluxos voláteis, liquidez elevada, compras de ETFs de ouro físico e diversificação oficial gradual.
pt-BR.key_risk: Fluxos combinados negativos e recomposição de fundos monetários podem sinalizar seletividade, não rotação generalizada de risco.
